Job Title
Portfolio Excellence Intern – Hair Care (Global Consumer Marketing)
Job Description
Job title:
Portfolio Excellence Intern – Hair Care (Global Consumer Marketing)
Your role:
Join the global Hair Care Business Category team and help turn portfolio and commercial data into clear insights and actions. You’ll support the Senior Consumer Marketing Manager and colleagues across Global Portfolio, regional marketing, Sales, Finance and other functions.
This is a hands-on internship for someone who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how portfolio strategy, pricing, promotions and innovation come together in a global consumer business.
Your role
You’ll help the team understand how the Hair Care portfolio is performing, prepare for upcoming commercial and innovation priorities, and keep plans and inputs organized across regions. Your responsibilities will include:
Analyze portfolio and business performance: Gather and structure sales, market share, distribution, pricing, promotion and SKU data. Help track performance against targets and flag trends, gaps and potential opportunities for the team to explore.
Build clear reporting and insights: Maintain and improve Excel trackers, dashboards and review materials. Summarize what the data shows in clear charts, takeaways and presentations for regional and global discussions.
Support portfolio reviews: Help assess SKU performance, contribution and assortment effectiveness. Prepare analyses that support discussions about hero products, portfolio gaps, SKU simplification and opportunities by market, retailer or channel.
Coordinate go-to-market planning: Support regional planning for new product introductions and other key commercial initiatives. Maintain launch-readiness trackers, consolidate market inputs, and help teams stay aligned on milestones, assortment and activation plans.
Support pricing and promotion work: Organize inputs for pricing and promotion analyses, line-chart development and regional implementation. Help prepare materials for commercial discussions and retailer or category reviews.
Track category priorities and actions: Help prepare regular performance reviews and follow up on agreed actions with markets and cross-functional partners. Support the coordination of key promotional periods and peak events.
Bring market and competitor information together: Consolidate relevant consumer, retailer, market and competitive inputs into concise overviews that help inform portfolio and go-to-market discussions.
The team and your development
You’ll be part of the global Hair Care Business Category team and work closely with the Senior Consumer Marketing Manager. You’ll collaborate with regional market teams and partners in Global Portfolio, Sales, Finance, Innovation and other functions.
You’ll gain practical experience in portfolio management, commercial analytics and regional go-to-market planning. You’ll see how teams use performance data to make decisions about products, markets, pricing, promotions and launches. You’ll also build your Excel, presentation, communication and coordination skills in an international working environment.
You're the right fit if:
Experience and education
You’re currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Analytics, International Business or a related field.
You have experience using data in coursework, a student project, part-time role or internship. Experience in marketing, business analytics, category management or commercial planning is helpful, but not essential.
You’re interested in consumer products and curious about how products are planned, launched and managed across different markets.
Skills and approach
You’re confident using Excel, including pivot tables, formulas and organizing or cleaning data. Experience with Power BI, Tableau or another visualization tool is a plus.
You can work carefully with detailed information and large or varied datasets, and you enjoy finding the story behind the numbers.
You can explain findings clearly and turn analysis into useful charts, summaries or recommendations.
You’re organized and comfortable coordinating inputs, timelines and follow-ups across several teams.
You communicate well in English, both written and spoken, and are comfortable collaborating with people in different roles and markets.
You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and follow tasks through. You’re comfortable learning as you go and handling business information with discretion.
We offer you :
A non-stop growth opportunity within Marketing and Communication but also within a global multinational company. In addition, we also want to renumerate you well for the opportunity. This includes:
Monthly full-time allowance between €500 - €700 gross, depending on your education level and if you need to relocate to The Netherlands. Part-time internships receive the allowance pro-rata.
Housing compensation. Should you need to relocate to near our office, we’ll offer you a monthly allowance of €300,- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, we’ll just ask for the rental contract from your landlord, and your usual home-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1.5 hours of travel time (for a one way trip).
Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport card; you will receive max. €192,- net as a monthly allowance.
Paid holidays per internship term.
The opportunity to buy Philips products at our Philips shop.
How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
About Philips
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

Job Title
Internship: Synthetic Data Generation for Dental AI (Master)
Job Description
Start Date: January/February 2027
Duration: minimum 6 months
Type: Internship
Weekly Presence: 40h (minimum 32h)
Location: Eindhoven
Internship: Synthetic Data Generation for Dental AI (Master)
Philips has a long history of successfully introducing innovative products to the market (lamps, CD players, medical imaging equipment, patient monitors, etc). Today, Philips is 100% health technology company with Data and AI being an integral part of Philips strategy. This internship develops a scalable pipeline for generating photorealistic synthetic intraoral images and automatic ground-truth labels from 3D jaws. Tooth detection and instance segmentation are the primary validation case. The same approach should also support other intraoral AI algorithms, such as gumline localization and detection of cavities or other oral conditions. Building on previous work in 3D jaw reconstruction and SAM mask generation/distillation, the project will quantify how synthetic data affects accuracy, robustness and the synthetic-to-real domain gap.
Your challenge: We are looking for an enthusiastic candidate who is passionate about computer vision, 3D graphics and deep learning.
Your team: You will be working in the R&D department of Philips Oral Healthcare in Eindhoven. The department works on cross-domain competences required to develop cutting-edge oral healthcare innovations, like machine learning, microbiology, sensors, optical imaging.
Your role:
Review 3D/synthetic dental data, rendering and domain-randomization methods.
Build a data-generation pipeline from reconstructed or parametric 3D jaws.
Vary anatomy, camera pose, lighting, materials and oral conditions.
Export images with masks, depth, normals and tooth labels.
Train/evaluate tooth detection and identification models; report conclusions.
Draft a technical note or paper; present results at a Philips R&D forum.
You're the right fit if:
MSc. in Data Science, CS, AI, Mathematics, Physics or Biomedical Engineering.
Experience with Python programming is essential.
Good knowledge of deep learning and computer vision in PyTorch.
Passion for 3D modelling, rendering and synthetic data generation.
Experience with Blender, 3D reconstruction or generative AI is a plus.
Language: good written and spoken English.
Previous internship experience is not necessary but is a plus.
Good communication skills and enthusiasm to work in an international team.
How we work together
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
Monthly full-time allowance between €500 - €700 gross, depending on your education level. If you need to relocate to The Netherlands specifically for the internship there will be a different allowance. Part-time internships receive the allowance pro-rata.
Housing compensation, in case of relocating to the vicinity of the office, €300,- net if location is in the vicinity of Amsterdam, €255,- net for all other Philips locations. To be eligible, your usual home-work travel distance needs to be more than 50 km or 1.5 hours of travel time (one way). Afterwards, you need to provide the rental contract from your (new) landlord.
Travel compensation, if you are not eligible for a free public transport (OV chipkaart - student travel product); you can receive max. €192,- net depending on your location. Paid holidays per internship term.

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
